articles.title: Team develops modulator for compact photonic integrated circuits
articles.description: Researchers at Skoltech have developed an ultra-compact electro-optic modulator based on silicon photonics and plasmonics that enables high-efficiency optical signal control within a small device footprint. articles.title: Why is Gen Z choosing ringing phones over endless notifications?
articles.description: Gen Z is reviving landline-style communication as part of a growing analog trend focused on reducing screen time and setting digital boundaries. Once considered essential, landlines now symbolise intentional tech use. From “landline mode” to redesigned devices, this shift reflects a desire for control, clarity, and relief from constant online noise.
